description.value: iDen & Quanjude is a Beijing Duck House restaurant established in 1864, specializing in authentic Beijing-style Chinese cuisine. Located on Cambie Street in Vancouver with indoor seating and on-site wheelchair-accessible washrooms, it provides a full-service dining option for touring cyclists seeking substantial meals.
